  bndbreak = function(s)

    s = s:gsub(hash .. hash, hash)
    local after = { ["."] = true, ["_"] = true, ["/"] = true, [":"] = true, [","] = true,

      prev = ch
    end
  end
}

\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-not-ensemble-tom3}{The instance is not \texttt{Ensemble.toM3} of the eight tables}
\fhead{Evidence} The blueprint:
\begin{leancode}
def leanIsaInstance (prog : Program) (s : Sizes) : M3Instance   -- `Ensemble.toM3` of the eight tables with
                                                               -- leanISA's separators and directions; the
                                                               -- layout of `witness.rs:67-101`, `leaf.rs:53-156`
\end{leancode}
\src{docs/roadmap/protocol-blueprint.md:803-805 at b435631}
\bndc{bp:77}: \enquote{which \bndc{Ensemble.toM3} derives from any Clean \bndc{Ensemble}};
\bndc{bp:21}: \enquote{the polynomial view of any Clean ensemble}. Against it: the status file's
decision that \enquote{the fixed columns are \bndc{Coord.known} data} (decision 8,
\bndc{protocol-status.md:220-223}), the spine's \bndc{boundary} field and \bndc{Coord.known}
(\bndc{Spine/Instance.lean:86-98, 136}), leanVM's three framework blocks per side
(\bndc{layout.rs:352-395}; \bndc{08-end-to-end-protocol.tex:70}, \enquote{three blocks per side
belong to no table}) whose program columns the verifier evaluates itself (\bndc{leaf.rs:453}),
and \cref{sec:gen-boundary-trap}: an instance whose blocks are tables of \bndc{q} makes
\bndc{satisfiedBy_witnessOf} unprovable (probe \bndc{KnownColumn}). An \bndc{M3Instance} also
needs \bndc{μ}, \bndc{layout}, \bndc{publicLines}, \bndc{aux}, \bndc{Stmt}, none of which a Clean
\bndc{Ensemble} has, so no \bndc{Ensemble.toM3 : Ensemble → M3Instance} exists;
\bndc{Ensemble.toM3} is listed as an interface (\bndc{bp:1369, 1398}) and given no signature.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the instance of Layer 3 (\code{bp:803-805})}
\asis the comment quoted above.
\asproposed \enquote{\bndc{Component.toM3} of the six opcode tables, with leanISA's separators
and directions and their count columns; three column groups for the shared committed columns
(\bndc{mem_0, mem_1, mem_2, cntfin_mem} at \bndc{2^logMem}; \bndc{cntfin_bc} at
\bndc{2^prog.logSize}; \bndc{q_flock} at \bndc{2^(τ_5 + 8)}), tables with no constraint, flush or
count; six boundary blocks written from \bndc{memTable}, \bndc{bytecodeTable} and
\bndc{leanIsaVerifier prog} with \bndc{idx ↦ Coord.known (idxColumn κ)}, the entry cells
\bndc{↦ Coord.known (bytecodeSlotColumn prog k)}, the sentinel
\bndc{↦ Coord.const prog.finalPc}, the limbs and counts \bndc{↦ Coord.committed}; the layout of
\bndc{witness.rs:67-101}, \bndc{leaf.rs:53-156}; three public lines; \bndc{aux} the Flock
predicate of the region}. Delete \bndc{Ensemble.toM3} from \bndc{bp:77, 1369, 1398} and from the
sentence at \bndc{bp:21}, or define it as the six-table part only.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-bridge-lemma}{No bridge lemma for the boundary blocks}
\fhead{Evidence} Layer 2's two bridges are \bndc{toM3_constraints_iff} and
\bndc{toM3_flushes_eq} (\bndc{bp:775-777}), both about a Clean \bndc{Table} read as an instance
\emph{table}. The three balances of \bndc{SatisfiedBy} range over \bndc{w.interactions}, which
include the memory block's, the bytecode block's and the verifier's rows
(\bndc{Clean/Air/FlatEnsemble.lean:225-226} at \bndc{93c9d1ef}; \bndc{Statement.lean:207-209}); in
the instance those are \bndc{boundaryTuples}, not \bndc{flushTuples}
(\cref{sec:gen-boundary-m3holds,sec:gen-boundary-trap}). Nothing in Layers 2 or 3 states that the
messages of \bndc{bytecodeRowOf prog i c}, \bndc{memRowOf mem i c} and \bndc{leanIsaVerifier prog}'s
row are the boundary tuples, coordinate by coordinate.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (omission).

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{a third bridge lemma in Layer 3 (\code{bp:810-819})}
\asis no lemma relates the two block components and the verifier component to the instance's
boundary tuples.
\asproposed Add to Layer 3:
\begin{leancode}
theorem boundary_tuples_eq (h₁ : IndexColumnsAreRowIndices w) (h₂ : SeedRowsAreTheImage w)
    (h₃ : BytecodeRowsAreTheProgram prog w) (hs : Sizes.ofWitness w = some s) :
    the multiset of sixteen-tuples of the messages of w's memory block, bytecode block and
    verifier row on each side = (leanIsaInstance prog s).boundaryTuples (stackOf gen w hs) side
\end{leancode}
and its use in both adaptor theorems; add to Layer 2's tests \enquote{the three block components
against their boundary blocks on the one-row witness}.
\reason Without it neither direction of the adaptor can be proved, and it is the one place the
program's \bndc{known} columns meet the program's rows.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-base-soundness}{The base soundness theorem omits \texttt{WellFormedBytecode}, and is not a statement about \texttt{verify}}
\fhead{Evidence} The blueprint:
\begin{leancode}
theorem baseVerifier_extractsExecution (fs bcs mca flock) (h : verify prog input proof = true) :
    except with probability niError, ∃ t, ValidExecution prog input t
\end{leancode}
\src{docs/roadmap/protocol-blueprint.md:1247-1248 at b435631}
which \enquote{composes … \bndc{constraintSoundness}} (\bndc{bp:1253-1254}); but
\bndc{constraintSoundness (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog)} (\bndc{leanisa-blueprint.md:1163};
\bndc{architecture.md:224-228}; the documentation dossier, \file{docs-debt.md} B.6). The
\bndc{JUMP}-sentinel program has two rows that are steps and balance the state channel with no
\bndc{ValidExecution} for the image (\bndc{tests/LeanerVMTests/Semantics/Execution.lean:415-461},
proved), so the theorem is false without the hypothesis. The \enquote{except with probability}
attaches to \bndc{verify prog input proof = true}, a closed Boolean of the concrete BLAKE2s
verifier, which has no probability; the theorem must be about the random-oracle verifier of
\bndc{verify_iff_compiled}, and the step to the concrete \bndc{verify} is the random-oracle
heuristic, stated nowhere (\cref{sec:gen-boundary-hypotheses}). The conclusion mentions no
extracted witness, so the statement is a soundness statement for a language
(\cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-composition}, probe \bndc{Transport} examples 3--4).

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the base soundness theorem (\code{bp:1247-1248})}
\asis the excerpt above.
\asproposed
\begin{leancode}
/-- Base soundness, in the random-oracle model: for a well-formed program and an input on
which no execution exists, every prover with at most `Q` oracle queries makes the
Fiat–Shamir-compiled verifier of `leanIsaInstance prog s` accept with probability at most
`niError Q` (the maximum over admissible `s`; finding 6). `verify` is that verifier with the
BLAKE2s chain in place of the oracle (`verify_iff_compiled`), which is a heuristic and not a
theorem. -/
theorem baseVerifier_sound (fs bcs mca flock) (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ t, ValidExecution prog input t) : ∀ prover, Pr[compiled verifier accepts] ≤ niError Q
/-- Pointwise, for the extractor's stack: what recursion consumes (T6). -/
theorem execution_of_extracted (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog) (hs : s.Admissible prog)
    (h : M3Holds (leanIsaInstance prog s) input q) :
    ∃ t, AssignmentRepresents (witnessOf prog s q) t ∧ ValidExecution prog input t
\end{leancode}
(\enquote{finding 6} in the docstring is \cref{f:boundary-announced-sizes}.) And in the prose: who
establishes \bndc{WellFormedBytecode} (the compiler, \bndc{lean_compiler/src/lib.rs:162},
\bndc{filler.rs}; a check of guest correctness on the exact guest), and that the random-oracle
instantiation is a hypothesis of the deployment, not of any theorem. The same two edits in the
tracker's section on the base theorem (K4, \bndc{hole-comment.md:190}).
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-base-completeness}{The base completeness theorem is false without resource hypotheses and needs a witness generator}
\fhead{Evidence} The blueprint:
\begin{leancode}
theorem baseProver_complete (hfill : HasFillBlocks prog) (h : ValidExecution prog input t) :
    verify prog input (prove prog input (witness of t)) = true
\end{leancode}
\src{docs/roadmap/protocol-blueprint.md:1249-1250 at b435631}
which \enquote{composes \bndc{constraintCompleteness}, \bndc{m3Holds_stackOf},
\bndc{piop_perfectCompleteness} and the determinism of the Fiat–Shamir chain}
(\bndc{bp:1255-1257}).
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item \bndc{HasPublicBoundary} allows \bndc{κ = 32} (\bndc{Execution.lean:108-110}); a valid
  execution at \bndc{κ = 16} is one at \bndc{κ = 32} with the image extended by zeros (the same
  run); its four memory columns hold \bndc{4 · 2^32 = 2^34 > 2^28} cells, and the verifier rejects
  \bndc{μ > 28} (\bndc{cpu/mod.rs:174-176}, \bndc{pcs.rs:51}; \bndc{verifier.py:1379});
  \bndc{AssignmentRepresents} fixes \bndc{κ} (\bndc{Statement.lean:358}), so no witness of \bndc{t}
  is provable.
\item \bndc{constraintCompleteness} gives \bndc{∃ w}; \enquote{\bndc{witness of t}} is a function
  the blueprint excludes (witness generation, T2, out of scope, \bndc{bp:147-148}).
\item \bndc{constraintCompleteness} takes \bndc{WellFormedBytecode prog}, not
  \bndc{HasFillBlocks prog} (\bndc{leanisa-blueprint.md:1165}).
\item The rate is not chosen by \bndc{t}.
\end{enumerate}

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the base completeness theorem (\code{bp:1249-1250})}
\asis the excerpt above.
\asproposed
\begin{leancode}
/-- Base completeness: a satisfying witness whose sizes are admissible and any valid rate give
a proof `verify` accepts. -/
theorem baseProver_complete (gen : FlockWitnessGen) (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog)
    (h : SatisfiedBy prog input w) (hs : Sizes.ofWitness w = some s) (hadm : s.Admissible prog)
    (hρ : validRate ρ) : verify prog input (prove gen prog input w ρ) = true
/-- With leanISA's existence theorem: a valid execution that some admissible-size witness
represents has an accepted proof. -/
theorem baseProver_complete_of_execution (hwf : WellFormedBytecode prog)
    (h : ValidExecution prog input t)
    (hfit : ∃ w s, SatisfiedBy prog input w ∧ AssignmentRepresents w t ∧
      Sizes.ofWitness w = some s ∧ s.Admissible prog) : ∃ proof, verify prog input proof = true
\end{leancode}
and in the prose: \enquote{The resource condition \bndc{architecture.md:273-275} asks for is
\bndc{hfit}: the stacking window forbids \bndc{κ > 26} and long runs; \bndc{constraintCompleteness}
alone does not give admissible sizes (and, as sketched, has no resource hypothesis of its own,
\cref{f:boundary-completeness-resources})}. Ask the leanISA roadmap (\emph{Boundaries},
\bndc{bp:1433-1441}) for a \bndc{constraintCompleteness} that returns a witness of \emph{minimal}
heights, or accept \bndc{hfit} as the base theorem's hypothesis. The same in the tracker's section
on the base theorem.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-sizes}{\texttt{Sizes}, \texttt{Sizes.ofWitness} and \texttt{admissible\_iff\_caps} cannot be stated as written}
\fhead{Evidence} The sketch (\bndc{bp:795-801}, quoted in \cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-rate}).
\bndc{logInvRate} is announced (\bndc{cpu/mod.rs:118-124}, \bndc{verifier.py:1372-1376}; not in the
specification's Setup, \bndc{08-end-to-end-protocol.tex:55}) but no witness determines it, so
\bndc{Sizes.ofWitness w : Option Sizes} is ill-defined;
\bndc{admissible_iff_caps : s.Admissible prog ↔ (Caps w ∧ Sizes.ofWitness w = some s)} has a free
\bndc{w} and, quantified, is false in both directions (\bndc{Caps} lacks the \bndc{μ} and rate
windows, \bndc{Statement.lean:79-81}; another \bndc{w} has other sizes);
\bndc{Sizes.ofWitness (w : EnsembleWitness leanIsaEnsemble)} lacks \bndc{prog} (\bndc{bp:799});
\bndc{leanIsaInstance_fits} uses \bndc{layout.total} (\bndc{bp:808}), a field \bndc{Layout} has not
(the Layer 1 dossier, \file{code-layer1.md} G.2). The bus dossier has the caps side
(\cref{f:bus-admissible}).

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the sizes (\code{bp:795-808})}
\asis the sketch of \cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-rate}.
\asproposed
\begin{leancode}
structure Sizes where (logMem : ℕ) (τ : Fin 6 → ℕ)                 -- the family index
def Sizes.ofWitness (w : EnsembleWitness (leanIsaEnsemble prog)) : Option Sizes
def leanIsaBlocks (prog) (s) : Blocks ; def leanIsaμ (prog) (s) : ℕ  -- witness.rs:67-101
theorem leanIsaBlocks_fits : (leanIsaBlocks prog s).total ≤ 2 ^ leanIsaμ prog s
def Sizes.Admissible (prog) (s) : Prop  -- 16 ≤ logMem ≤ 32, τ j ≤ 32, 3 ≤ τ 5, leanIsaμ prog s ≤ 28
def validRate (ρ : ℕ) : Prop := 1 ≤ ρ ∧ ρ ≤ 4                        -- whir_config.rs:48-55, Layer 12
theorem caps_of_admissible (hs : s.Admissible prog) (q) : Caps (witnessOf prog s q)
theorem sizes_of_satisfiedBy (h : SatisfiedBy prog input w) : ∃ s, Sizes.ofWitness w = some s
\end{leancode}
\reason The instance depends on the heights alone; the rate is Layer 12's; the two lemmas are what
the two directions use.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 6
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-announced-sizes}{The composition over the prover's announced sizes is unspecified}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-sizes-exists}: \bndc{verify_iff_compiled} quantifies
\bndc{∃ s} (\bndc{bp:1218-1221}), \bndc{verify_knowledgeSound}'s error is \bndc{niError s Q}
(\bndc{bp:1226-1227}), the per-instance theorems bound one \bndc{s}, and ArkLib's
\bndc{ProtocolSpec n} cannot express a protocol whose schedule depends on a first message. A union
over the admissible sizes costs about $2^{34}$; the \bndc{Q · max ε} bound needs
\bndc{FiatShamirSecurity} stated for the family with \bndc{s} in the hashed input.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (a missing decision).

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the family of instances (\code{bp:316}, \code{bp:1226-1227}, \code{bp:1326-1328})}
\asis the convention \emph{Statements and parameters} (\bndc{bp:316}) says the instance indexes
the protocol family and nothing of how the error composes over it; Layer 12 states the error as
\bndc{niError s Q}.
\asproposed In \emph{Statements and parameters} add: \enquote{The sizes are the prover's. The
non-interactive theorem is stated for the family: its error is
\bndc{niError Q := max over admissible s of niError s Q} (or the sum, if the interface is per
instance), and \bndc{FiatShamirSecurity} is the family form, the challenge oracle taking the
announced sizes with the statement}. In Layer 12 (\bndc{bp:1226-1227}) replace \bndc{niError s Q}
by that. In acceptance test 21 (\bndc{bp:1326-1328}) add \enquote{the error of \bndc{verify} does
not depend on the prover's choice}.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 7
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-flock-circular}{The instance depends on a Flock interface that depends on the instance}
\fhead{Evidence} \bndc{bp:846-848}: the instance's layout takes its slot map from
\bndc{FlockInterface.limbColumns}, and \bndc{structure FlockInterface (I : M3Instance)}
(\bndc{bp:1077}); \bndc{aux} of \bndc{leanIsaInstance} must be Flock's R1CS (the strong reading,
decision 12), which only the Flock roadmap (issue \#3) defines; the consequence lemma
\enquote{R1CS $⇒$ the limbs compress} that \bndc{satisfiedBy_witnessOf} consumes
(\bndc{bp:855-857}) has no carrier in any signature (\bndc{satisfiedBy_witnessOf}'s arguments,
\bndc{FlockInterface}'s fields, \bndc{FlockWitnessGen}). The Flock dossier proposes the split
(\cref{f:flock-ring-slot-map-circular,f:flock-ring-opaque-aux}); the Layer 1 dossier the reader
(\file{code-layer1.md} G.1).

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.

\fhead{Proposed change} Layer 3 takes, and the Flock roadmap supplies, one instance-free
structure:
\begin{leancode}
/-- What the adaptor needs of Flock, none of it mentioning an instance. -/
structure FlockSpec where
  slot : Fin 18 → Fin 256                                   -- hash_flock.rs:87-115
  Holds (kBatch : ℕ) : Column (8 + kBatch) → Prop            -- the R1CS on the packed column
  decHolds : ∀ k, DecidablePred (Holds k)
  compress_of_holds : Holds k c → ∀ j, Blake2sRelation (limbs read at slot j of c)
  gen : (rows : List (Blake2sRow K)) → Column (8 + kBatch)   -- keeps the limbs in their slots
  holds_gen : (∀ r ∈ rows, Blake2sRelation r) → Holds k (gen rows)
\end{leancode}
\bndc{leanIsaInstance (F : FlockSpec) prog s} uses \bndc{F.slot} in its layout, \bndc{F.Holds} as
\bndc{aux}; \bndc{satisfiedBy_witnessOf} uses \bndc{F.compress_of_holds}; \bndc{stackOf} uses
\bndc{F.gen}, \bndc{m3Holds_stackOf} uses \bndc{F.holds_gen}; \bndc{FlockWitnessGen} and
\bndc{FlockInterface.limbColumns} are deleted; the phase-level \bndc{FlockInterface} keeps the
reduction and its two proofs and takes the \bndc{FlockRegion I} of the Flock dossier
(\cref{f:flock-ring-opaque-aux}), whose \bndc{aux_iff} is \bndc{F.Holds}.
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 8
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-poly-bridge}{The polynomial bridge of Layer 2 is noncomputable at the pin}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-poly}: \bndc{bp:762-771} produce Mathlib
\bndc{MvPolynomial}s; the instance holds \bndc{CMvPolynomial}s (\bndc{Spine/Instance.lean:123-125});
\bndc{toCMvPolynomial} is \bndc{noncomputable def} (CompPoly \bndc{3468b38c},
\bndc{Multivariate/MvPolyEquiv/Core.lean:41}; the same \bndc{noncomputable def} at the same line at
\bndc{572f9973}, read with \bndc{git show} of the new pin); \bndc{M3Holds} is meant to be decided
by evaluation and \bndc{verify} to be computable (\bndc{bp:866-867, 1230-1231}). Probe
\bndc{PolyBridge}: the direct translation is computable and agrees with \bndc{Expression.eval}.

\fhead{Classification} A deviation forced by an upstream library, with a workaround: the direct
translation; retired if CompPoly makes \bndc{toCMvPolynomial} computable.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the polynomial bridge (\code{bp:762-767})}
\asis
\begin{leancode}
def Expression.toMvPolynomial : Expression F → MvPolynomial ℕ F     -- var i ↦ X i
theorem eval_toMvPolynomial (env : Environment F) (e) :
    MvPolynomial.eval env.get e.toMvPolynomial = e.eval env
def Expression.degreeBound : Expression F → ℕ                      -- syntactic; add max, mul sum
theorem totalDegree_le_degreeBound (e) : e.toMvPolynomial.totalDegree ≤ e.degreeBound

\end{leancode}
\asproposed \enquote{\bndc{def Expression.toCMvPolynomial (n) : Expression K → CMvPolynomial n K}
(var \bndc{i < n} $↦$ \bndc{X i}, else \bndc{0}, as \bndc{Environment.fromArray} reads a missing
cell);
\bndc{theorem eval_toCMvPolynomial (row) (e) : (e.toCMvPolynomial n).eval (fun i ↦ row[i]?.getD 0) = e.eval (Environment.fromArray row data)};
\bndc{theorem fromCMvPolynomial_toCMvPolynomial (e) : fromCMvPolynomial (e.toCMvPolynomial n) = rename … e.toMvPolynomial},
through which \bndc{degreeBound} bounds \bndc{totalDegree} (\bndc{totalDegree_equiv})}.
\bndc{M3Table}'s fields become \bndc{CMvPolynomial}; \bndc{Direction} becomes \bndc{Side} (or the
spine adopts leanISA's \bndc{Direction}). Clean \#466 (\bndc{Expression.toMvPolynomial}) stays the
proof-side bridge.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 9
\begin{finding}{major}{f:boundary-column-groups}{The column-only tables enter the generic table sumcheck's schedule}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-tables}; \bndc{bp:836-839} (the six shared columns are
\enquote{tables of the instance with no constraints and no flushes}); Layer 7's \bndc{τ_max},
\enquote{one value per column of every table} (\bndc{bp:987-989};
\bndc{08-end-to-end-protocol.tex:76-77}; \bndc{constraints.rs:250}, the six tables); the bus
dossier's note (\cref{f:bus-table-phase-tables}). A phase over the abstract \bndc{I} that ranges
over all of \bndc{I.ntab} has a different transcript from leanVM's on the leanISA instance, which
\bndc{verify_iff_compiled} would then fail.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (a consequence of the modelling choice, unstated).

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{column groups (\code{bp:316}, \code{bp:987})}
\asis nothing says how a phase over the abstract instance treats a table with no constraint, no
flush and no count column.
\asproposed In the spine's conventions (\bndc{bp:316}, or a new row \emph{Column groups}):
\enquote{A table with no constraint, no flush and no count column is a column group: it takes no
part in the table sumcheck (no round, no term, no column value) and its columns receive claims
from the boundary blocks, the public lines and the Flock phase only.
\bndc{M3Instance.active j := (I.constraints j ≠ []) ∨ (I.flushes j ≠ []) ∨ (I.counts j ≠ [])} is the
criterion, decidable, and Layer 7 ranges over it.} In Layer 7 (\bndc{bp:987}): \bndc{τ_max} and
\bndc{Σ_j width_j} over the active tables.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 10
\begin{finding}{minor}{f:boundary-witnessof-stackof}{\texttt{witnessOf\_stackOf} has no Lean statement}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-stackof}; \bndc{bp:819}
(\enquote{\bndc{= w  -- on the committed fields}}), \bndc{bp:1339}
(\enquote{\bndc{#guard witnessOf (stackOf w) = w}}), \bndc{bp:866-867}. \bndc{EnsembleWitness} has a
function field and a free width and no \bndc{DecidableEq}.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the round trip (\code{bp:819}, \code{bp:1339}, \code{bp:822-824})}
\asis \bndc{theorem witnessOf_stackOf (hs) : witnessOf prog s (stackOf gen w hs) = w  -- on the committed fields}
and \bndc{#guard witnessOf (stackOf w) = w}.
\asproposed at \bndc{bp:819}, the statement of \cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-stackof}
(\bndc{rowCells}, the three equalities under \bndc{SatisfiedBy} and \bndc{Sizes.ofWitness}); at
\bndc{bp:1339}, \enquote{\bndc{#guard} of those three equalities on the one-row witness}. Say in
\bndc{bp:822-824} that neither composition of the base theorem uses it.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 11
\begin{finding}{minor}{f:boundary-witnessof-input-counts}{\texttt{witnessOf} has no \texttt{input}, and the count columns have no derivation}
\fhead{Evidence} \bndc{bp:813-814}; \bndc{bp:773-777} (\bndc{Component.toM3 (c) (sep) (dir)} with a
\bndc{count} field and no rule); \bndc{layout.rs:412-414}; \cref{tab:gen-boundary-conjuncts}, the rows
of \bndc{public_input_eq} and \bndc{counts_nonzero}.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (imprecision).

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the adaptor's map and the count columns (\code{bp:813}, \code{bp:773-774})}
\asis \bndc{def witnessOf (prog) (s) (q : Column (leanIsaInstance prog s).μ)} and
\bndc{def Component.toM3 (c : Component F) (sep : RawChannel F → F) (dir : RawChannel F → Direction)}.
\asproposed At \bndc{bp:813}: either add \bndc{(input : PublicInput)} to \bndc{witnessOf} (the
\bndc{Refinement.map} has the statement) or say \enquote{the lanes are read off cells 0 and 1 of
\bndc{mem_0}, \bndc{mem_1}}. At \bndc{bp:773-774}:
\bndc{Component.toM3 (c) (sep) (dir) (lookups : List (RawChannel F))} with \enquote{\bndc{count} is
coordinate 2 of every pull on a channel in \bndc{lookups}, required to be a variable
(\bndc{vars_lt_width}'s sibling \bndc{count_is_var})}, and the test \enquote{the count columns of
the six tables are those of \bndc{count_columns()} (\bndc{layout.rs:412-414})}.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 12
\begin{finding}{minor}{f:boundary-reducible}{\texttt{leanIsaInstance} must be reducible}
\fhead{Evidence} Probe \bndc{DefInstance} (\cref{sec:gen-boundary-probe-definstance}): the
adaptor's statement elaborates on a \bndc{def} instance, but no \bndc{Decidable} instance is found
for \bndc{M3Holds (inst …) input q}, while the \bndc{abbrev} passes; the toy is an \bndc{abbrev} for
that reason (\bndc{Spine/Toy.lean:94-95}); the Layer 3 tests decide \bndc{M3Holds}
(\bndc{bp:866-867}).

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (omission of a constraint on the code).

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the instance's definition (\code{bp:803})}
\asis \bndc{def leanIsaInstance (prog : Program) (s : Sizes) : M3Instance}.
\asproposed \enquote{\bndc{abbrev leanIsaInstance …}, reducible, so that
\bndc{Decidable (M3Holds (leanIsaInstance prog s) input q)} and the instances on \bndc{I.Stmt} are
found by instance search, as the toy is}.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 13
\begin{finding}{minor}{f:boundary-refinement-polarity}{\texttt{Refinement.map\_option\_valid} has the wrong polarity for ArkLib's game}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-st-composition}; \bndc{ToArkLib/Refinement.lean:55-57};
\bndc{Security/Basic.lean:316} at \bndc{dca90385} (the bad event is
\bndc{∀ w ∈ w?, (x, w) ∉ relIn}); probe \bndc{Transport}, \bndc{bad_of_bad}. Harmless (a case split
on the \bndc{Option} converts), and the spine dossier's \bndc{knowledge_transport}
(\file{code-spine.md}) is the probabilistic form.

\fhead{Classification} Imprecision.

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the transport the base theorem composes (\code{bp:407}, \code{bp:552}, \code{bp:582-586})}
\asis \bndc{T4  =  verify_knowledgeSound  ∘  Refinement.map_option_valid satisfiedBy_witnessOf  ∘  constraintSoundness}
(\bndc{bp:407}).
\asproposed At \bndc{bp:552} and \bndc{bp:582-586}, name \bndc{Refinement.knowledge_transport}
(the event form, \file{code-spine.md}) as what the base theorem composes, and keep
\bndc{map_option_valid} as the pointwise lemma of the honest direction; the line at \bndc{bp:407}
becomes
\enquote{\bndc{T4 = verify_knowledgeSound ∘ Refinement.knowledge_transport satisfiedBy_witnessOf ∘ constraintSoundness}},
and the tracker's \bndc{knowledgeSound_of_refinement} (\bndc{hole-comment.md:190}) the same.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 15
\begin{finding}{minor}{f:boundary-parse}{Two deployed checks are discharged by type, and nobody is told to parse}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-other-program}, item 2: \bndc{read_public}'s checks (2)
(the public words' third limb, \bndc{cpu/mod.rs:141-143}) and (3) (the bytecode length and, in the
Python, decodability) are \enquote{by type} in Lean (\bndc{Statement.lean:71-75});
\bndc{verify : Program → PublicInput → Proof → Bool} (\bndc{bp:1217}) takes the typed values; the
fixture (\bndc{bp:1236-1240}) and end-to-end soundness's (T7) \bndc{PublicInput.encode} are the
parsers.

\fhead{Classification} An error of the blueprint (omission).

\fhead{Proposed change}
\begin{change}{the convention \emph{Verifier shape} (\code{bp:326})}
\asis \enquote{Structure checks on public data that the Rust \bndc{assert!}s (finding F10) are
theorems about the layout, not branches of \bndc{verify}.}
\asproposed Add: \enquote{\bndc{verify} takes a \bndc{Program} and a \bndc{PublicInput}; the
deployed verifier's rejection of a public word with a nonzero third limb and of a bytecode that is
not \bndc{2^k ≤ 2^32} decodable instructions are the obligations of whoever builds those values
from bytes (the fixture's loader in Layer 12, \bndc{PublicInput.encode} in T7), and the
differential fixture records a rejected public input as a parse failure, not as
\bndc{verify = false}}.
\end{change}
\end{finding}

\begin{finding}{note}{f:boundary-extracted-witness}{The base theorem (T4) drops the extracted witness that recursion (T6) needs}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-architecture}, the last paragraph;
\bndc{architecture.md:332-335}: \enquote{the extracted leanVM witness should contain ordered
\bndc{pc}/\bndc{fp} steps and the full memory image}.
\bndc{baseVerifier_extractsExecution} keeps only \bndc{∃ t, ValidExecution prog input t}.

\fhead{Proposed change} The second theorem of the proposal of \cref{f:boundary-base-soundness}
(\bndc{execution_of_extracted}).
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 17
\begin{finding}{note}{f:boundary-non-adaptive}{The protocol's soundness is non-adaptive in the statement}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-sizes-exists}, the last paragraph: ArkLib's games quantify
\bndc{∀ stmtIn} outside the probability (\bndc{Security/Basic.lean:299-323}); end-to-end
soundness's (T7) public input has a prover-chosen part (\bndc{architecture.md:191-195, 357-358}).

\fhead{Proposed change} Record in the blueprint's \emph{Out of scope} that adaptive statement
soundness in the random-oracle model (the input seeds the chain, \bndc{cpu/mod.rs:712}) is
end-to-end soundness's to state and is not given by the per-statement theorems of this roadmap.
\end{finding}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- 18
\begin{finding}{note}{f:boundary-completeness-resources}{\texttt{constraintCompleteness} needs a resource hypothesis of its own (leanISA's)}
\fhead{Evidence} \Cref{sec:gen-boundary-hypotheses}: \bndc{Caps.heights} bounds every table by
\bndc{2^32} rows (\bndc{Statement.lean:257}), \bndc{ValidExecution} bounds only \bndc{κ}
(\bndc{Execution.lean:108-115}), and a halting run visits distinct \bndc{(pc, fp)} states (the step
is a function of the state and the fixed image), so a run of more than \bndc{2^32} steps of one
opcode has no satisfying witness. The claim that a halting run visits distinct states is an
argument from the determinism of the step, not a Lean proof. Out of this review's scope; it
reaches the base theorem through \cref{f:boundary-base-completeness}.

\fhead{Proposed change} Report to the leanISA roadmap (\emph{Boundaries}, \bndc{bp:1433-1441}).
\end{finding}
